text:
Samir: Heads-up — finalizing the Acclivity customer story. Need to lock interview time, legal ok on quote usage, and confirm webinar slot for launch week. Proposed dates: Tue 3/9 or Thu 3/11. Prefer AM PT.
anya_k: Tue works for the customer. Can we do 10am PT? Also they requested quote redaction for a metric (ARR).
mason: 10am PT good. Quick ask on assets — can design get product screenshots + 30s demo clip by EOD Monday? @nora_marketing to coordinate.
nora_marketing: I'll collect screenshots. Do we have permission to use their logo on homepage hero? Legal said we'd need written opt-in.
priya: I'll ping Legal. Also we need to confirm lead routing: should webinar registrants go to AE queue or SDR? My recommendation: SDR first-touch, tag as 'acclivity_case_webinar' UTM.
Samir: Agreed on SDR routing. Add `acclivity_case_webinar` to utm_campaign and GTM event. Also plan a short pre-recorded clip for the webinar.
anya_k: About quote — customer approved the paraphrased line but wants numbers redacted. LegalOps: any redline?
legal_ops_bot: @priya @samir Legal reviewed the draft. Two notes: 1) Remove specific ARR figure unless customer supplies written consent. 2) Add standard attribution paragraph. See redline: `[[REDACTED ARR]]`.
priya: Noted. I'll send the consent form template. Also need to confirm localization — do we want Spanish captions for the clip at launch?
nora_marketing: Yes please. Let's prioritize Spanish and French. Localization ETA: +3 business days after final asset.
mason: For the blog post — will we run the benchmark callout? We ran internal perf tests showing ~22% latency reduction; need permission to claim that.
Samir: Only if the customer signs off. For the internal benchmark mention let's phrase as 'our joint tuning yielded significant latency improvements' unless they approve numbers.
anya_k: I'll ask them. Also embargo date: can we target Monday 3/15 9am PT for publish and webinar week of 3/22?
priya: Slack reminder: set email nurture to route hot leads to SDRs with tag + create playbook for AE follow-up. I'll draft playbook and share.
nora_marketing: I'll prepare a launch checklist: hero image, blog draft, quote approvals, webinar landing page, UTM links, social posts. Need final assets by 3/10 EOD.
Samir: Great. If anyone hits blockers, drop in this thread or ping me. Thanks :thumbsup:
